szoveg_eredeti:
Knowing things → doing things → finding ways to save you time and money

We’re expanding Tasks in Gemini free of charge to hundreds of millions of people in six countries. Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Tasks lets you hand off everyday life admin directly:

- Forward emails to gemini@google.com to RSVP and add it to your family calendar
- Have Gemini call local businesses to compare price quotes and check inventory (with full transcripts + approval before dialing)
- Check out securely via Google Pay (uses the Agent Payments Protocol - AP2)
- Seamlessly sign in via Google Password Manager

We wanted to make this helpful + secure, we’re also partnering directly with major websites and security providers so it works well for site owners and agents.
